title: OSAP at Skinwalker Ranch and the hitchhiker effect
summary: Jesse Michels tells of OSAP at Skinwalker Ranch and the hitchhiker effect, about 2007-2012 at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: which is that the OSAP program which ran from 2007 to 2012 under the opices of Harry Reid a lot of these guys were digging holes and looking into kind of exotic weaponry and they were doing it on Skinwalker Ranch and a lot of them reported this quote unquote hitchhiker effect.
Recall that DIA funded a two-year or so effort to research the ranch.
tellings.difference: Says DIA funded it, gives it about two years (c. 2008-2010), credits Lacatski, Kelleher and Knapp, and doesn't mention the hitchhiker effect.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe the government-funded research program at Skinwalker Ranch in the late 2000s (OSAP/AAWSAP).
